details.text: Today and tonight. There is a Marginal Risk, or level 1 out of 5, for thunderstorms to produce damaging wind this evening across areas of eastern Ohio, generally along and west of Interstate 77.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Friday through Wednesday. A strong cold front will bring showers, possible thunderstorms, and gusty wind from 30 to 40 mph to the region on Friday. There is a Marginal Risk, or level 1 out of 5, for thunderstorms to produce damaging wind gusts for areas generally east of Interstate 79. Wind gusts from 30 to 40 mph will likely continue Friday night before diminishing on Saturday. Cold temperatures could result in widespread frost and freeze conditions Saturday night into Sunday morning.
